Regression excerpts derived from real Wave3 sidecar and geometry fixtures. Root polygon and scalar/vector sediment mutations reproduce W3C review cases. Summary metadata and counts are deliberate mutations, with coincident geometry counts and renamed datasets; they supplement the full real-file oracle. No compute fixture qualification is claimed.

W3D adds scalar/rank-three/rank-four summary derivatives retaining the qualified
Sibling. `../../generate_w3d_excerpts.py` regenerates these three excerpts with
h5py/numpy; `w3d-provenance.json` records source and generated SHA256 hashes.
These malformed files test refusals and absence of panics, not qualification
of new schemas.
